outcome.answer: The directly relevant study computationally examines political bias in Nation.Cymru, a Welsh political news outlet, using RoBERTa to detect bias and an LLM to classify sentiment toward political parties. It reports differential framing: Reform UK receives biased framing more often and more negatively than Plaid Cymru, while a broader analysis finds Plaid Cymru receives more favourable framing than the other parties examined. The study covers one outlet and calls for broader review; it does not establish bias across Welsh media as a whole. [1]
